mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Chandra's Outrage: "Chandra's Outrage deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that
# creature's controller."
# 4 to the target: M21 Turn to Slag's DEAL_DAMAGE to a TARGET creature (B5c-turn-to-slag) with 4.
# 2 to that creature's controller: the ruling R_ITSCONTROLLER (MAPPER_GUIDE), M20 Chandra, Flame's
# Fury's verified -2 form, copied exactly: every player who controls the target, read through
# CONTROLLER_IS over the players with the `target` referent (not a target, CR 115.1; the creature
# as it last existed, CR 608.2h). This is the ruling's worked draft
# (reports/rulings_2026-11-17/itscontroller_chandras_outrage.py).
# R_ITSCONTROLLER
its_controller = Selector(
    count=QUnbounded(), mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE, filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),), referent='target')),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),))
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Seq(steps=(
            A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
                'amount': QConst(value=4),
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            }),
            A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'target': its_controller}),
        )),
    ),
]

mapping.notes: The ruling R_ITSCONTROLLER's form, copied exactly (MAPPER_GUIDE; M20 Chandra, Flame's Fury's verified -2): 4 to the TARGET creature, then 2 to every player who controls it, read through CONTROLLER_IS over the players with the 'target' referent (no player target, CR 115.1). Replaces the stale needs-atom note (209 §1). clauses.clause: Chandra's Outrage deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
clauses.evidence: SpellAbility INSTANT, Seq: DEAL_DAMAGE 4 to a TARGET Selector over Creature; DEAL_DAMAGE 2 to ALL players whose controller-is is the referent 'target' (the ruling R_ITSCONTROLLER's exact shape). Probe: 'target slot (cast): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]'; every cast: the creature 'is dealt 4 damage', then its controller is dealt 2 ('you is dealt 2 damage' for you_bear and you_giant, 'opp is dealt 2 damage' for the four opponent creatures, life 20 -> 18 on the right side only), the creature dies after the spell has resolved. The probe's snapshot reads ownership, so a stolen creature, the response timing and the fizzle are in packs H06_1, H06_2, H06_3, H06_5; instant speed on the opponent's turn in H06_4.
